name: elrobot-policy
description: Run a trained LeRobot 0.6.1 policy (ACT or SmolVLA) on an ElRobot follower arm (7 joints + gripper) with its arm and table cameras. Loads a pinned Hugging Face model revision and stops safely: back to the start pose, then torque off.

variables.name: PORT
variables.description: Port for the policy runner's web page (status, camera pictures, Start and Stop; also the calibration page): open http://<device>:<port> in a browser

variables.name: FOLLOWER_SERIAL_DEVICE
variables.description: USB serial tty of the ElRobot follower arm (12 V). ttyACM1 on the team's Jetson; check with ls -l /dev/serial/by-id/ on the device. It must be connected when you deploy.

variables.name: CALIBRATION_VOLUME
variables.description: Persistent volume that holds the follower's LeRobot calibration file (follower.json); the same volume elrobot-record uses
